title: Wingthing: refuse stale remote actions before SSH attachment
description:
## Source:

Binding spec: /work/lanes/skeptic/inputs/mac/drive/wingthing-app-spec.md and /work/lanes/wt-app/PRD.md. Original item/comments: /work/lanes/refine-wingthing/evidence/fleet-y9t6.show.json and .comments.json.

Card: 03/card-5, ordinal #6: Remote offline or stale inventory
Source: /work/lanes/wt-e2e/wingthing/evidence/storyboard-source/03-navigator.html#6
Carrier: f8f9ebd96e1c72336ffd796c8d496ecda0a85619; Linux forge; isolated HOME/WINGTHING_DIR; fixture provider/SSH, real built wt + kernel PTY.

Expected screen: Offline forge with last-success/stale rows; local still attachable
Expected observable state: Stale attach refused; no fallback, exit inference or provider mutation

Actual outcome across three runs: FAIL, FAIL, FAIL.


## Why

Bryan gets a clear validation refusal and keeps local work usable during remote outages.

## The one question / capability

Can Bryan safely act on local work while a remote inventory is stale?

## Scope

Repo: ehrlich-b/wingthing. Base: codex/wt-integration-20261011 @ 3a0b7fa8578b9889d9e17a0e5fb3a1ffab9831ca. Branch: codex/refine-fleet-y9t6-20261011; isolated checkout, record actual head and binary hash. internal/dashboard/actions.go and remote inventory validation; cmd/wt/remote.go adapter and tests. Consolidate TestStoryboardNavigatorCard5 and TestStoryboardMachinesCard3 from existing wt-e2e. Apply only stale/offline pre-action validation; preserve current exact-route and live disconnect handling.

## Non-goals

No duplicate source-DONE implementation, Linux confinement bypass, public release/deploy, account/payment/provider spend or external outreach. Bare wt stays primary; free SSH/LAN/tailnet stay available and automatic Pro offers default OFF. Use disposable fixture sessions and installer transports; actual user/native/physical acceptance remains separately evidenced.

## Acceptance

Enumerate both card tests and run each three times on integrated source. Select cached forge row after a failed refresh; attach/takeover/rename/stop must refuse before opening a session SSH action or sending mutations, naming unvalidated stale target and Refresh/revalidate next action. Count fixture SSH action invocations separately from background inventory probes: zero action attempts while stale. Same-name local fallback, exit inference and provider relaunch remain impossible. Local rows and local attach remain usable; reconnect/fresh validated inventory permits the original pinned wing/session only. A disconnect after previously valid action admission remains outcome-unknown, not the new pre-validation refusal. go test -race ./internal/dashboard ./internal/remote ./cmd/wt, vet/full suite against baseline; no new failures, preserve exact host/pin denial tests. Merged source-card obligations (original transcripts retained in evidence/<id>.show.json):

fleet-vzf3 (TestStoryboardMachinesCard3): Offline forge/stale inventory plus available local attachment
Expected observable state: Cannot validate remote action; no same-name local fallback
 MOCKS-FIRST: proposed happy/failure screenshots must receive builder self-review and separate product-review PASS against each named view question before UI implementation; revise and re-review failed mocks, then review actual screenshots/transcripts after build.

## UI contract / MOCKS-FIRST gate

User: Bryan gets a clear validation refusal and keeps local work usable during remote outages. One question per view: Offline machine: which cached work is unvalidated, and which local work can I still open? Reference: /work/lanes/wt-app/storyboard (flow matching source card), existing dense keyboard navigator and docs/pairing/STORYBOARD.html. Before UI build, capture happy/failure mock screens at narrow/wide sizes with readable focus/status, then self-review and obtain independent product-review PASS. Revise failures before building; review actual screenshots/transcripts again after build.

## Review loop

Builder reviews every diff/card expectation against the one question and clear/purposeful/testable/minimal/deduplicated/no-one-shot rubric. Independent gpt-6.1-sol high implementation/evidence review before handoff; security reviewer checks policy, cursor or route authority changes. Fix findings and re-review. Product mocks must pass before UI work; coordinator integrates shared files serially.

## Dependencies

Blocking IDs: fleet-jugv. Tracking parent is not a blocker. Preserve native/physical gates and current active owner; do not create another suite lane.

## V/C

V=9/10; C=4 remaining agent-hours including implementation/qualification and review, excluding human wait. Rationale: Bryan gets a clear validation refusal and keeps local work usable during remote outages. Original V/C=6/1.3 uses board scheduling units, retained in evidence rather than compared as hours.
